name: slay-the-bear
description: A memecoin and a town game on NEAR: burn $SLAY to hit the Bear, share its hoard when it dies. Every move is a NEAR transaction and every random roll comes from drand, verified on-chain.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.build:contract: cd contracts/game && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --no-abi
scripts.build:contract:reproducible: cd contracts/game && cargo near build reproducible-wasm
